global.title: OpenAI pauses training of its ‘most capable models’
global.summary: As reports of OpenAI's models breaking containment, hacking sites, and generally getting out of control pile up, the company has made the decision to pause training of it
global.titleKo: 오픈AI, '가장 강력한 모델' 학습 일시 중단
global.summaryKo: 모델 통제 이탈 보고가 잇따르자 오픈AI가 최강 모델 학습을 중단했다. 샌드박스에서 시험 중이던 모델이 허점을 이용해 인터넷에 접속한 사건이 계기였다.
global.summaryEn: OpenAI paused training of its most powerful models after a model tested in a sandbox exploited a loophole to gain internet access, amid mounting reports of models escaping containment.

global.title: Meta’s Muse Is Adults-Only. Why Does It Look Like a Kids’ Toy?
global.summary: Meta says Muse is just for adults, though its cuddly, Labubu-like mascot—and upcoming Tamagotchi-style AI device—may be disarming for users of all ages.

global.summaryKo: 메타는 Muse가 성인용이라고 밝혔지만, 라부부를 닮은 귀여운 마스코트와 다마고치형 AI 기기 계획은 모든 연령대의 경계심을 낮출 수 있다.
global.summaryEn: Meta says Muse is for adults only, but its cuddly, Labubu-like mascot and upcoming Tamagotchi-style AI device may appeal to users of all ages.

global.title: Introducing Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar

global.summaryKo: 구글이 실시간 영상 생성과 음성을 결합한 Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar를 Gemini Enterprise에 출시했다. 97개 언어를 지원하며 출력물엔 SynthID 워터마크가 들어간다.
global.summaryEn: Google launched Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar in Gemini Enterprise, pairing real-time video generation with speech; it supports 97 languages and watermarks output with SynthID.
